title: Agent Cases
description: Turn proven conversations into reusable assets. Each case keeps its source workspace, session, model, and validation state so it can later evolve into versions, evaluations, and delivery packages.

create.title: Save as an Agent Case
create.description: This saves an asset index and reproducibility evidence without copying conversation content, API keys, or OAuth credentials.
create.name: Case name
create.namePlaceholder: For example: Competitor research report generator
create.summaryPlaceholder: Describe the problem, intended users, and current validation result
create.tagsPlaceholder: Separate tags with commas, for example: research, report, market

provenance.reproducible: Current environment matches the archived versions
provenance.drifted: Current environment differs from the archived versions
provenance.legacy: This legacy case has no version evidence. Re-archive the source conversation to create reproducible evidence.

empty.title: No Agent Cases yet
empty.withSource: Save the current proven conversation as your first case, then keep testing and improving it.
empty.withoutSource: Return to the main view, open an existing conversation, and save it as a case.

messages.verificationPassed: Verification passed; the current environment can reproduce this case
